sources_status.label: Cornerstone 2024 independent regional comparison
sources_status.note: Independent reconstruction from public EPA code, not an EPA-published release. The description says AR5, annual CO2e mass uses AR6 fossil methane, and the companion comparison uses AR6 non-fossil methane. WattDocket explicitly recalculates AR5 from annual gas masses and retains both published AR6 variants and the discrepancy. This source never automatically replaces the official baseline or supplies facility measurements.
sources_status.coverage: 27 eGRID regional-code comparisons; no verified 2024 site/utility assignment

sources_status.label: Reviewed operator-disclosure identity evidence
sources_status.note: A coverage relationship is not equality of reporting boundaries. Inventory changes require re-review; unreviewed names and cities never create a link.
sources_status.coverage: Five disclosure locations linked to six registry records by reviewed primary evidence; no numeric allocation

sources_status.label: EPA ECHO facility inventory
sources_status.note: An industry-code listing is not verification that a site is a data center. Missing coordinates are retained. Permitted capacity is not electricity use.
sources_status.coverage: NAICS 518210, all ECHO programs; 479 air-source records

sources_status.label: EPA eGRID annual emissions rates
sources_status.note: Annual location-based CO2e accounting rates; not hourly or marginal emissions. The edition check date is separate from the data year.
sources_status.coverage: 27 US eGRID subregions, including Alaska and Hawaii

sources_status.label: EPA eGRID primary and overlapping grid regions
sources_status.note: EPA polygon parts are repaired with strict area gates, then unioned only within each named region. Exterior rings, holes and MultiPolygons are retained. Server and local simplification each use at most 0.001 degree; their errors can compound, requiring a 0.0021-degree boundary guard. Per-feature repair receipts and rejected simplification attempts are retained. This supports geographic context, not proof of the serving utility. Utility-overlap areas and near-boundary points must be withheld until utility evidence resolves the ambiguity.

sources_status.label: EIA-930 national hourly electricity
sources_status.note: Original reported MW values; imputed and adjusted streams are retained only in raw source files. UTC hour-ending labels are shifted back one hour for interval starts. Forecasts do not establish freshness. Missing data remain null. Hourly carbon is withheld because current EIA carbon series are not sufficiently populated; no fuel-factor estimate is substituted.
sources_status.coverage: 60 Lower-48 balancing authorities; generation-only authorities may have no demand

sources_status.label: ERCOT five-minute fuel mix
sources_status.note: Missing intervals are explicit gaps. Storage is separate from generating fuels. MW values are not mislabeled as MWh. No unsupported hourly carbon factor is applied.
sources_status.coverage: Texas ERCOT grid; five-minute reported generation by fuel

sources_status.label: EPA GHGRP selected data-processing combustion reports
sources_status.note: GHGRP reported direct stationary-combustion emissions for regulatory facilities classified by the publisher under NAICS 518210. Only Subpart C rows are accepted. The total sums the publisher's gas-level CO2-equivalent quantities, excluding biogenic CO2. Reporting may use calculation methods; this is not a continuous measurement, electricity Scope 2, lifecycle footprint, or complete operator footprint. Multiple GHGRP facilities sharing one FRS identifier remain separate reporting entities. A reported address can be a corporate contact address, not a physical site.
sources_status.coverage: 6 regulatory reporting entities under NAICS 518210, Subpart C only; not all datacenters

sources_status.label: Google 2025 reported water by location
sources_status.note: Operator-reported annual location disclosure. Withdrawal and discharge use meters or invoices where available; the report permits estimates where data is unavailable. Consumption is withdrawal minus discharge. Individual rows do not disclose their metered-versus-estimated share. Named reporting locations may include multiple buildings. The source itself supplies no EPA identifier or meter-to-record match. Separately reviewed coverage links are shown with identity evidence; location totals remain unallocated. Excludes seawater and brackish water; no 2026 actual-use claim.
sources_status.coverage: 40 named Google locations worldwide; aggregates retained separately; reviewed record links do not allocate totals

sources_status.label: Meta 2024 reported campus electricity, water and emissions
sources_status.note: The operator uses activity data where available and permits estimation when activity data is incomplete. Reported values are rounded to whole units; the metered or estimated share of an individual campus row is not specified. Named operator data-center campus/location as published; it may contain multiple buildings. The report provides no building-level allocation or EPA facility identity link. Independent reviewed identity evidence is required before linking this disclosure to inventory records. Electricity is MWh, water is withdrawal, and emissions accounting methods remain distinct.
sources_status.coverage: 18 named worldwide Meta campuses, five distinct annual metrics each; no building-level allocation
